plainText:
Kain (Japanese: ケイン Cane) is a recurring character who first appeared in Going for a Spinda!.

==History==
=== ===
Kain became Claire's fiancé after the pair met in a flower field. Kain is a Pokémon adventurer who travels the world in search of rare Pokémon. As a result, he had to leave, but he left his in Claire's care as a sign of his devotion to her. 

Kain eventually returned and reunited with Claire at the place where they first met after Spinda ran away. He attempted to battle , but Spinda's was reflected back at it and it was subsequently captured. Thanks to 's Pokémon, Team Rocket was defeated and Spinda was returned to him and Claire.

=== ===
Kain appeared again in Battling as Hard as Stone!, watching and 's Masters Eight Tournament battle on television.
